status: WORK-only claim-ready proposal; not claimed, not authorized for source edits
selected_contract: Kafka4.3 uniform sticky state machine with Rust admitted conservative packed-byte accounting; adaptive=false
public_api_constraint: Existing Partitioner signature/object safety and all current struct-literal layouts remain compatible. A defaulted descriptor hook activates Producer-owned lifecycle; existing custom implementations opt out automatically. Cloned configs must not share mutable sticky topic state across independent Producer::new instances.
defaults_constraint: Default unkeyed global round robin and keyed murmur2 (including Some(empty)) unchanged; explicit partitions and custom partitioners retain prior routing/normalization. Opt-in only.
cohort_obligations: Counter advances only on actual successful enqueue/append: record_size_upper_bound plus61B once when a new admitted cohort opens, separate from retained-payload permit bytes.

A route token is prepared once and reused by fast/fallback; no mutation on failed readiness/buffer/channel admission. Stale generation is rejected before enqueue; original absolute max_block and delivery budgets are retained.
All keyed/explicit/unkeyed admissions to a partition participate in its bounded tail/cohort ledger; only unkeyed append deltas charge the sticky counter.
Rotate atB with a genuinely full/empty tail or at2B regardless; random draws may reselect the same partition. Partial linger/flush drain belowB preserves accumulated sticky bytes.

Attach internal inline topic-lifetime/generation/cohort tags to Pending; opt-in grouping/take_count must not merge separately charged same-partition cohorts. Preserve existing retry/idempotent batch identity and never recharge retries.

Sealing takes a fixed admitted-membership snapshot. Actual worker partial/full drain, expiry, purge, routing replacement and shutdown retire precisely those cohorts; stale notifications cannot reopen a new topic lifetime.

Prefer complete bounded opt-in cohorts in each request, preserving existing max_request_size and single oversized-valid-record progress. Aggregate multiple-partition request caps and member retrieval must not strand or silently split a cohort without accounting.
Default mode keeps existing batching path. In opt-in mode keyed routing stays identical but keyed/explicit records share real cohort boundaries with unkeyed records.

bounded_state.idle_eviction: only retire rows no longer pinned by required drain notifications
bounded_state.capacity_pressure: uncached uniform selection with singleton/full cohort instead of new admission errors or unbounded allocation; degraded stickiness must be named and captured
bounded_state.cleanup: close/last-handle shutdown clears state; changed known topicUUID/deletion/removed future partition invalidate only unadmitted tokens; transient leaderlessness or metadata-age refresh does not reset sticky history
bounded_state.limits: No exact Java accumulator/compression/timestamp byte-history parity; no indefinite Java topic history after bounded eviction; missing UUID cannot detect recreation as strongly

admission_locking_review_gate: No await, user interceptor/partitioner callback, network operation, or metadata refresh under the policy lock.

Use one documented order for final metadata/generation validation and policy commit, preferably cluster -> policy; never acquire cluster/nodes/fast from inside policy. Release both before waiting for channel/buffer or retry.

Tokio channel reservation is not itself a record append. Permit::send has no error return: explicitly prove receiver-close races before adopting it. Prefer committing the real synchronous try_send under the short policy critical section so Full/Closed outcomes cannot charge bytes; an async path may wait for capacity outside the lock and retry within the original deadline.
Worker notifications use the same short policy lock, so they cannot observe an enqueued member before its admission ledger entry commits.
completed_model: 19 source-derived Python cases; not Java/Rust/runtime qualification
benchmark_source_scope: Not claimed: root must name/delegate exact driver and Java/C peer paths before edits. Separate keyed/unkeyed/null-broker/current-broker profiles report accounting contract/seed availability/leader eligibility; native time-sticky is distinct. No performance claim without measured qualification.
